Not all mineral is created equal! 🐄
Heritage Nutritionist Tommy Wise recently spoke at the Wood County Beef Cattle Improvement Association’s summer picnic, where he compared weatherized mineral and meal mineral and explained the differences between the two.
The biggest takeaway? Keep cattle on a mineral they will consistently consume year-round. Consistent intake helps ensure your herd is getting the nutrition it needs in every season.
#HeritageCooperative #CattleNutrition #BeefCattle #MineralNutrition #LivestockNutrition #OhioAgriculture

45d Photo from Heritage Cooperative on Facebook at 9/2/26 at 7:50PM
Farm safety starts with being prepared! Sign-ups are now open for the Marysville FFA Chapter’s Farm Safety Kit Giveaway.
The first 40 farmers to sign up will receive a complimentary safety kit. Preference will be given to Union County farmers. Pickup will take place in Marysville, Ohio in mid-September, and farmers who secure a kit will be contacted with additional details.
Heritage Cooperative is proud to help make this project possible through our support of the Ohio FFA Chapter Success Grant Program.
Sign up here: https://h-coop.com/4qD0Fs1
